title: Fourier coefficient under domain translation
statement: Let $f\colon\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ and let $z,\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$. Translating $f$ by $z$, so that its value at $x$ is $f(x+z)$, multiplies its vector Fourier coefficient at $\gamma$ by the Walsh character associated with the support of $\gamma$, evaluated at $z$.
